t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each gnome has different coloured baskets. The yellow ones are best go for those.

vb_textbox.text: For the first 1 and a half trials, find the yellow baskets and stick with those. Remember them with an anagram if need be. Mine were Blue, Orange, Green, Yellow or BOGY and the Red baskets were the opposites.For the remaining 2 and a half rounds, find the red baskets. I got almost 4000 points doing it this way.Good Luck!
